questions.question: This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below. (Left) 941 915 741 807 776 (Right) Example: 697 — First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7 Note: All operations to be done from left to right. What will be the resultant if the third digit of the highest number is added to the first digit of the lowest number?
questions.questionHtml:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 941 915 741 807 776 (Right)

Example: 697 — First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7

Note: All operations to be done from left to right.

What will be the resultant if the third digit of the highest number is added to the first digit of the lowest number?
questions.solution:
Highest number = 941
Third digit of 941 = 1

Lowest number = 741
First digit of 741 = 7

Now,

1 + 7 = 8

Answer: A) 8

questions.question: P is Q’s father. R is Q’s sister. S is P’s wife. How is S related to R?
questions.questionHtml: P is Q’s father. R is Q’s sister. S is P’s wife. How is S related to R?
questions.solution:
P is Q’s father.

R is Q’s sister, so R is also P’s child.

S is P’s wife, so S is the mother of P’s children.

Therefore, S is R’s mother.

Answer: (a) Mother

questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘JOKE’ is coded as ‘NIOY’ and ‘TRICKY’ is coded as ‘XLMWOS’. What is the code for ‘SPEAKERS’ in the given code language?
questions.questionHtml: In a certain code language, ‘JOKE’ is coded as ‘NIOY’ and ‘TRICKY’ is coded as ‘XLMWOS’. What is the code for ‘SPEAKERS’ in the given code language?
questions.solution:
Logic: Alternate letter shifting is used: +4, -6, +4, -6...

JOKE → NIOY
J + 4 = N, O - 6 = I, K + 4 = O, E - 6 = Y

So,

SPEAKERS → WJIUOYVM

Answer: A) WJIUOYVM

questions.question: Find the missing term in the given analogy. JAP : BSH :: NDZ : FVR :: LCX : ?
questions.questionHtml:
Find the missing term in the given analogy.

JAP : BSH :: NDZ : FVR :: LCX : ?
questions.solution:
Logic: Apply the same letter-position changes: -8, +18, -8

Solution

JAP → BSH
J - 8 = B
A + 18 = S
P - 8 = H

NDZ → FVR
N - 8 = F
D + 18 = V
Z - 8 = R

Similarly,

LCX → ?
L - 8 = D
C + 18 = U
X - 8 = P

So, LCX → DUP

Answer: (b) DUP

questions.question: In the following question, a statement is given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Find which conclusion(s) is/are true based on the given statement. Statement: A ≥ B = C > D ≤ E < F Conclusions: I. A > D II. F > D
questions.questionHtml:
In the following question, a statement is given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Find which conclusion(s) is/are true based on the given statement.

Statement:

A ≥ B = C > D ≤ E < F

Conclusions:

I. A > D
II. F > D

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follow

questions.solution:
Statement:
A ≥ B = C > D ≤ E < F

Conclusion I: A > D
A ≥ B = C > D
So, A > D is true.

Conclusion II: F > D
D ≤ E < F
So, F > D is true.

Answer: (c) Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.question: AS 9 is related to UU 2 in a certain way. In the same way, BT 6 is related to VV -1. To which of the following is HG 9 related, following the same logic?
questions.questionHtml: AS 9 is related to UU 2 in a certain way. In the same way, BT 6 is related to VV -1. To which of the following is HG 9 related, following the same logic?
questions.solution:
Logic: Letters shift and number decreases by 7.

AS 9 → UU 2
A + 20 = U, S + 2 = U, 9 - 7 = 2

BT 6 → VV -1
B + 20 = V, T + 2 = V, 6 - 7 = -1

Similarly,

HG 9 → BI 2
H + 20 = B, G + 2 = I, 9 - 7 = 2

Answer: D) BI 2

questions.question: 122 is related to 145 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 37 is related to 50. To which of the following is 82 related?
questions.questionHtml: 122 is related to 145 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 37 is related to 50. To which of the following is 82 related?
questions.solution:
122 is near 11² = 121 and 12² = 144
Difference = 144 - 121 = 23
122 + 23 = 145

37 is near 6² = 36 and 7² = 49
Difference = 49 - 36 = 13
37 + 13 = 50

Similarly,

82 is near 9² = 81 and 10² = 100
Difference = 100 - 81 = 19
82 + 19 = 101

Answer: C) 101

questions.question: If 15 August 2024 was Thursday, then what day of the week was 26 January 2025?
questions.questionHtml: If 15 August 2024 was Thursday, then what day of the week was 26 January 2025?
questions.solution:
Logic: Count odd days between the two dates.

15 August 2024 = Thursday

Days from 16 August 2024 to 26 January 2025:

16 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 26 = 164 days

164 ÷ 7 = 23 weeks + 3 odd days

Thursday + 3 days = Sunday

Answer: (c) Sunday

questions.question: There are 30 students in a classroom arranged in a row. Reena is 5th from the left and Sushma is 12th from the right. Find the number of students between Reena and Sushma.
questions.questionHtml: There are 30 students in a classroom arranged in a row. Reena is 5th from the left and Sushma is 12th from the right. Find the number of students between Reena and Sushma.
questions.solution:
Total students = 30

Reena’s position from left = 5th

Sushma’s position from right = 12th
So, Sushma’s position from left = 30 - 12 + 1 = 19th

Students between Reena and Sushma:

19 - 5 - 1 = 13

Answer: (b) 13

So,

questions.question: Criteria to be selected as Lab Assistant as on 01-03-2024: Must have a Diploma in Lab Technology with at least 60% marks. Age must be 21 to 28 years. Should have minimum 1 year practical lab experience. Must be willing to work in night shifts. Special Clause: If the candidate has 70% in Diploma but only 6 months of experience, refer to Chief Lab Supervisor. Case: Irfan is 22 years old, has 72% in Lab Diploma, 6 months of experience, and agrees to night shifts. Question: What should be done in Irfan’s case?
questions.questionHtml:
Criteria to be selected as Lab Assistant as on 01-03-2024:

Must have a Diploma in Lab Technology with at least 60% marks.
Age must be 21 to 28 years.
Should have minimum 1 year practical lab experience.
Must be willing to work in night shifts.

Special Clause: If the candidate has 70% in Diploma but only 6 months of experience, refer to Chief Lab Supervisor.

Case: Irfan is 22 years old, has 72% in Lab Diploma, 6 months of experience, and agrees to night shifts.

Question: What should be done in Irfan’s case?
questions.solution:
Logic: Check all criteria first, then apply the special clause.

Solution

Irfan’s age = 22 years, so the age condition is fulfilled.

Diploma marks = 72%, so the minimum 60% condition is fulfilled.

Experience = 6 months, but minimum 1 year is required, so the experience condition is not fulfilled.

Special clause says that if the candidate has 70% in Diploma but only 6 months of experience, the case should be referred to the Chief Lab Supervisor.

Answer: (a) Refer to Chief Lab Supervisor
